description: Generate a Unity 6 (Android + iOS) mobile game project on this machine. Call game_describe first for the flags, defaults and validation rules. showcase has every flag on; flags and features apply to blank only. theme picks one of the style families game_describe lists under themes (palette, shapes, motion, fonts; match the family whose suits fits the game) and optionally a fontPair of that family. primary and accent (#RRGGBB) recolour the family: their lightness is shifted until text and buttons keep their contrast, and a colour that still cannot pass falls back to the family default with a warning. Without theme the template default family (clean) is used. Writes <outputDir>/<projectName>; never overwrites an existing non-empty folder.

companyName.description: Company name (defaults to the second packageName segment, capitalized)

features.description: blank only: extra feature modules (lower case names)

flags.description: blank only: flags from game_describe (required flags are added); showcase has every flag on

ids.description: Real IDs by group (admob, revenueCat, gameServices; fields in game_describe), each needing its flag. A group left out keeps the test IDs / placeholders, reported as a warning

outputDir.description: Absolute path of the folder to create the project in

projectName.description: Letters or digits, starting with a letter, no spaces (e.g. SkyHopper)

templateRef.description: Override the pinned game template tag

templateType.description: showcase (default): the sample games with every flag on; blank: an empty game with the flags and features you pick

theme.description: Style family and optional colour shifts; without it the template default family is used

accent.description: #RRGGBB accent colour; lightness is adjusted to keep contrast

family.description: A family id from game_describe themes.families (default: themes.default)

fontPair.description: One of the family's fontPairs (default: its first)

primary.description: #RRGGBB primary colour; lightness is adjusted to keep contrast

name: game_generate
